idea-plugin.name: DSH Computer History Companion
idea-plugin.description: Declares this IDE to the local Computer History Host, once per run, so the timeline can say which editor a workspace was open in instead of guessing it from a window title. The Host records the claim as a claim: it appears as provider: companion, and it is the allow-list and the protected set that decide whether anything is stored. No document text, selection or diagnostic is ever sent - the protocol has no field for them.
